summary: Completed testing of Iteration 286 - Agentic AI (Mews 2026 parity) and Vacation Rental dedicated view (Eviivo+Lighthouse parity). All 29 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI tests verified: 2 new sidebar entries present (Otonom AI Agent'lar, Vacation Rental apart), both panels load correctly with Turkish UI. Fixed 2 issues: (1) vacation_rental.py calendar endpoint KeyError on room_id, (2) App.js missing activeView entries for ai-agents and vacation-rental.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 286 fully tested. Two new modules added: (1) Agentic AI at /api/agents/* with auto-seeding of 3 agents (Misafir Memnuniyet, Operasyon Optimize, Revenue Pulse), agent CRUD, run execution with tool chains, approve/reject workflow. (2) Vacation Rental at /api/vacation-rental/* with summary KPIs, units list, and calendar grid for apartment-type properties. Frontend panels: AgentsPanel (data-testid=agents-panel), VacationRentalPanel (data-testid=vacation-rental-panel). All Turkish UI throughout.

endpoints: POST /api/agents (creates custom agent, validates name+mission required)
POST /api/agents/{id}/run (triggers execution, returns run with actions_taken, results, status)
verified: 3 seeded agents: Misafir Memnuniyet Agent, Operasyon Optimize Agent, Revenue Pulse Agent

Each agent has correct tools: Revenue Pulse → find_low_occupancy_dates + draft_promo_rule; Guest Recovery → find_low_reviews + draft_apology + propose_voucher; Ops → find_stale_oos + create_maintenance_ticket + estimate_revenue_loss
Agent run execution with tool chain

GET /api/vacation-rental/calendar?date=YYYY-MM-DD&days=14 (returns rooms grid with cells: date, status, guest_name)
verified: 4 apartment properties: aldgate-flats, camden-suites, london-suites, ryam-suites
KPIs: property_count, unit_count, total_revenue, total_nights, occupancy_percent, adr, revpar, booking_count
